title: x-chain Arena
tagline: x-Chain Arena is a medieval 32 bit, gladiator themed NFT game deployed on Cronos and Polygon testnets!
description: Users can come and mint either warrior, ranger, or mage!  Tavern fully release.  Sort through your NFT's on our frontend.  Arena and quests coming soon! Uses NFTPort.xyz for fully decentralized IPFS / Filecoin goodness!  32 Bit art with fulls creen backdrop!  Questing coming soon to level up your chaacters and wager in the Arena.
how_its_made: Made with ethers.js, bootstrap, and javascript!  Deployed metadata using NFTPort.xyz!  NFTPort made it quick and easy to upload a bulk directory of metadata, with plenty of room to take advantage of their free API calls for new developers and testing!  Arena wagers will allow players to risk their NFT and reign as the champion on thei respectv chain!
